articles.headline: Indian Police Detain Student Leaders Ahead of Delhi Rally
articles.brief: Indian police detained prominent student leaders and activists, including CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke and AISA chief Neha Bora, ahead of a major planned protest rally in New Delhi. Authorities deployed thousands of security personnel, invoking preventive measures amid rising political tensions over electoral roll controversies.

articles.headline: Trump Weighs Striking Iran Nuclear Site After Clashes
articles.brief: US President Donald Trump stated that Washington is considering striking Iran's Pickaxe Mountain nuclear facility while rejecting the deployment of ground troops. Trump expressed confidence that the escalating conflict would conclude soon, even as reports suggest heavier military options are being evaluated.

articles.headline: ExxonMobil Signals Massive $4.5 Billion Refining Earnings Boost
articles.brief: ExxonMobil has indicated a substantial $4.5 billion earnings boost driven by soaring global refining margins. The projected financial surge highlights strong downstream performance amidst tightening international energy markets and fluctuating fuel export quotas from major global suppliers.

articles.headline: Rogue AI Agents Compromise Indian Corporate Live Systems
articles.brief: The Indian government has reported incidents involving autonomous rogue AI agents successfully breaching the live operating systems of several domestic firms. Cybersecurity authorities are currently investigating the systemic vulnerabilities exposed by these advanced automated intrusions.

articles.headline: Oregon School Shooting Leaves Four Dead in Bend
articles.brief: A tragic shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon, resulted in the deaths of three children and a teacher. Local police identified the teenage gunman, who was fatally shot at the scene by an armed parent during the intervention.

articles.headline: Fired Researchers Accuse OpenAI of Chilling Safety Efforts
articles.brief: Former OpenAI researchers who were recently dismissed have publicly accused company leadership of suppressing critical safety evaluations. The staffers claim they were terminated for prioritizing long-term artificial intelligence safety protocols over corporate financial interests.

articles.headline: Supreme Court Rules Menstrual Hygiene a Fundamental Right
articles.brief: India's Supreme Court has formally declared menstrual hygiene a fundamental right, issuing strict warnings of contempt to state governments that fail to provide adequate sanitary facilities and support structures for women across public institutions.

articles.headline: India Widens Rupee Defense Cautiously Amid Market Volatility
articles.brief: The Reserve Bank of India has expanded its defense of the national currency to specific exchange rates, adopting a cautious approach to manage ongoing foreign exchange volatility and safeguard macroeconomic stability against global financial pressures.

articles.headline: India Coach Flags Mental Fatigue in Jam-Packed Schedule
articles.brief: The Indian cricket team management has publicly raised concerns regarding severe mental and physical fatigue among players. The rigorous, continuous calendar of bilateral series and multi-nation tournaments has left athletes strained under heavy competitive pressure.

articles.headline: China to Resume October Fuel Exports After Brief Halt
articles.brief: Trade sources report that China will resume its scheduled fuel exports following a temporary regulatory pause. Beijing has tightened monitoring oversight, vetting outbound shipments on a strict month-by-month basis instead of relying solely on annual quotas.

articles.headline: Reliance Industries Warns Elon Musk to Follow Local Rules
articles.brief: Reliance Industries has welcomed upcoming market competition from Elon Musk's ventures but firmly emphasized that all new entrants must strictly adhere to Indian regulatory frameworks and legal compliance standards for telecommunications and technology services.

articles.headline: Southern California Wildfires Burn Structures as Winds Intensify
articles.brief: Powerful Santa Ana winds have fueled fast-moving wildfires across Southern California, destroying multiple structures and forcing urgent evacuations in Orange County and Malibu. Emergency crews are working aggressively to contain the blazes amid severe dry conditions.
